summary_1line: Santanu marries the mysterious Ganga under a vow of non‑interference and silently watches her drown seven newborn sons before stopping her at the eighth.

image_candidates.scene_text: On the bank of the Ganges, the radiant maiden Ganga calmly casts a newborn infant into the flowing river while King Santanu watches in silent anguish.
Santanu first beholds the dazzling maiden by the sacred Ganges, her celestial ornaments gleaming as both gaze at each other with sudden love.
As Ganga lifts the eighth child toward the river, Santanu finally steps forward in desperation, raising his hand to stop her.
